blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Pi Durden Wangkay won bronze in the athletics men’s 200 meters on Tuesday, giving the Philippines its second medal at the 2026 Youth Olympic Games and securing its best-ever finish in four editions of the competition. Wangkay clocked a personal-best 21.36 seconds, narrowly missing silver to Guyana’s Deuquan’ Farrell by four-thousandths of a second in a photo finish. Zimbabwe’s Ropafadzo Mzondo won gold in 21.04. “I ran blind [on Lane 9],” said Wangkay, who was assigned the outside lane after posting the fifth-best time in the heats. “I never expected to medal, because I also had the fifth-best time in […]...
